routes: Web search and publisher primary records

Crossref works endpoint: exact DOI/title identity on 31 October 2026

benamor2026.title: Multiscale modeling and multiobjective optimization of the mechanical behavior of annealed and non-annealed material extrusion printed PLA
benamor2026.access_and_disposition: Publisher abstract/author conclusions; precedent for tensile FE validation and optimization on annealed MEX PLA.

bute2023.title: Thermal properties of 3D printed products from the most common polymers
bute2023.access_and_disposition: Publisher abstract (subscription full text). Red/LAVA PLA and directionally measured thermal behavior; do not assume formulation matches Black.

bute2024.title: Thermomechanical Analysis and Numerical Simulations of Fused Filament Fabricated Polylactic Acid Parts
bute2024.access_and_disposition: Primary full text local and publisher; sections 2.1–2.3 and 3.1–3.3. Black Devil Design TMA and qualitative thermal-stress comparison; no transferable Prusament law.

chapuis2023.title: Redeployable, 4D printed wave spring actuators
chapuis2023.access_and_disposition: Primary full article (ETH author repository). Sections 2.1.4 and 3.1–3.2, Tables 1–2. Original bath and two-grade architecture; height n=15, force test n=5.

chapuis2025.title: Thermo-viscoelastic laminate-based finite element modeling of fused filament fabrication direct 4D printing
chapuis2025.access_and_disposition: Local primary full article, supplementary PDF, ABAQUS input/mesh and UMAT. Sections 2.1–3.2; Tables 1–5 and Fig. 9. Constitutive calibration and separately reserved geometric/force observations.

frolich2025.title: Mechanical and kinetic characterization of additively manufactured PLA structures for improved process and warpage modeling
frolich2025.access_and_disposition: Primary ten-page KIT author PDF, sections Methods to Conclusions and Figs 1–6. Ultrafuse PLA, calorimetry, DMA and directional TMA; does not provide a validated arbitrarily timed anneal law.

frolichdeformation2025.title: An orientation-based homogenization approach for predicting process-induced deformations in extrusion-based additive manufacturing
frolichdeformation2025.access_and_disposition: Primary KIT repository/source and corresponding thesis chapter 6. Printing-process warpage, not post-annealing gap response.

hussam2025.title: Effect of annealing on FDM-manufactured ABS parts
hussam2025.access_and_disposition: Existing publisher primary HTML saved stage19; ABS mould-clearance precedent, not PLA coefficient.

kujawa2025.title: Sliding elements made from biodegradable plastic – friction and wear of poly(lactic acid) compared to polyamide 6
kujawa2025.access_and_disposition: Publisher primary Conclusions: finite sliding velocity, pressure and wear; not incipient near-static hot fixture contact.

lakshmaiya2026.title: Thermo-constrained physics informed neural network based optimization of mechanical performance in recycled PLA additive manufacturing
lakshmaiya2026.access_and_disposition: Publisher primary text, Methods/Results: recycled PLA strengths, surrogates and optimization. Not a gap-controlled prediction.

lorenzoni2024.title: Preliminary study on the impact of thermal processing on the performances of parts obtained by fused deposition modeling (FDM)
lorenzoni2024.access_and_disposition: Full paper via validation-audit teammate, pp. 103–104; hand-tightened Al plate-annealing precedent.

tough2025.title: Sustainable Thermal Post-Processing of PLA 3D Prints: Increased Dimensional Precision and Autoclave Compatibility
tough2025.access_and_disposition: Publisher primary Materials subsection: Ultrafuse PLA Tough, distinct formulation, not interchangeable with neat Ultrafuse.

limitations: Not a subscription Scopus/WoS search. One Bute thermal paper was accessible as publisher abstract only. Digitization of one thermal path cannot identify a general time-temperature law.
Prusament hits from recycled/filled/sensor/other polymer materials and forum discussions were screened out as evidence for the specified unfilled PLA.
Crossref metadata snapshots here contain identity fields and response hashes (raw response not redistributed). The original bibliography and Stage20 identity audit remain separate.
